evidence.detail: create_match() assigns players via `set(players)` which is unordered; the host is always players[0] per host() at line 42, but set() makes that position non-deterministic
import_header() passes players list in log-file order (host first per pdbot convention) to create_match(), but set() discards that ordering
host() returns self.players[0] unconditionally — correctness depends entirely on insertion order being preserved

triage.fix_sketch: In logsite/data/match.py line 90, change `set(players)` to `dict.fromkeys(players)` (or a manual dedup loop) to preserve the log-file order while still deduplicating. This keeps the player who triggered pdbot (and appears first in the log header) as players[0], i.e. the host. One-line change; no schema migration needed.
triage.notes: Historical records already in the database may have incorrect host assignments; the fix only affects future imports. Existing data correction would require a separate migration, but that is a separate decision.
